dct_description_sm: The data set was collected as an ongoing study at the Cape Bounty Arctic Watershed Observatory International Tundra Experiment (ITEX) site examining the environmental controls over trace gas respiration in High Arctic mesic tundra. The goal of the study is to characterize the relationships between plant-available nitrogen and productivity and to see how these relationships are manifested in hyperspectral signatures.
dct_title_s: Growing Season Trace Gas and Environmental Measurements at an Experimentally-Warmed Mesic Tundra Site
